wrong_findings.claim: “All 16 live pages have a unique title”
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The crawl and HTML show `/coffee/` and `/subscriptions/` share the same title.

wrong_findings.claim: Search Console reports “Submitted URL marked noindex” for `/wholesale/`.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The audit says Search Console data was unavailable, and no GSC evidence is provided to support this claim.

wrong_findings.claim: FAQ rich results are “limited to government and health sites.”
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The user-provided grading context says Google stopped showing FAQ rich results in May 2026; describing them as merely limited is outdated.

extra_true.finding: `/shop/` has short category copy and no links to gear or drip-bag products.
`/coffee/flores-bajawa/` is short and lacks a brewing section.
The site has no Open Graph or Twitter Card tags.
Missing paths return a bare server error page without navigation.
Blog posts have weak cross-linking and limited links to products.

notes: All 20 planted issues are identified with specific pages and problems. The audit lists 25 numbered findings; its summary severity counts do not add up to that total.
